parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the toilet is a flat, hinged cover made of plastic, typically located on top of the seat or tank.
parts.Functional_description: It serves to cover the toilet bowl or tank, maintaining hygiene and preventing odors from escaping.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate about a hinge, allowing it to open and close easily.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the toilet is the main ceramic structure that supports the seat and contains the bowl and water tank.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support, holds water for flushing, and connects to the plumbing system for waste disposal.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part anchored to the floor and plumbing connections.
